data.detailed_description:
You can read all routes in the free trial version (regular edition)!

You can read all stories in the free trial version of this game. Please purchase the donation version only if you wish to obtain Steam achievements.


Red Spider 2: Exiled Remastered Store Page Now Live

Thank you for your continued support of the Red Spider series. We have just launched the Steam store page for the next installment in the series, Red Spider 2: Exiled Remastered.

Continuing from the previous game, Red Spider 2: Exiled Remastered features fully illustrated scenes, utilizing over 1,000 cuts and dynamic camerawork to create a highly immersive cinematic visual novel experience.

The soundtrack features Yasunori Shiono (Lufia series) and welcomes Yukio Nakajima (Puzzle & Dragons). The much more intense ensemble drama is brought to life by a total of 34 voice actors (total recording time: 9.6 hours).

Just like the first game, you can play through the entire story and all endings completely "free of charge" in the Demo / Standard Edition. The paid "Donation Version" supports Steam achievements and includes a digital setting guide (common to the series, Japanese only).

Please add the game to your wishlist!

We will also be posting production reports in the news section, so please follow the new game's page as well.

About the Game

Gunsmoke, Neon, and Betrayal. A Hardboiled Revenge Story Dedicated to Classic Hong Kong Cinema.

Hong Kong, 2014—a city teeming with passion and conspiracy. The protagonist, Yvet, is a former assassin and now the wife of the Triad leader of the "Red Flower Society" organization in Kowloon. After her husband is suddenly attacked, the lone avenger finds herself isolated within the organization. Armed only with her old "killing skills" and a few trusted companions, she embarks on a solitary war against the ruthless culprits.
This game is a fully voiced visual novel created by an indie developer from Japan, made with deep affection for Hong Kong cinema.

Key Features

Unraveling the Truth from Multiple Perspectives

The story branches based on the partner you choose. A character whose true intentions were initially elusive may be revealed in another route as someone driven by a profound, hidden motive. Only by completing all six routes will the true "full picture" of the incident be unveiled.

A Hong Kong Noir Film You Can "Read"

Fully voiced, with over 530 hand-crafted cuts, and an estimated total playtime of 7-8 hours (approx. 1 hour per route). Rather than reusing standing character sprites, every scene is rendered as its own dedicated cut, unfolding like a graphic-novel-style film.
Homages to classic Hong Kong films and characters based on real-life famous actors immerse you in a deep, cinematic drama. The "Cyclopedia" included in the game provides detailed explanations of which scenes reference which films, and which characters are inspired by which actors.

Music by a Legendary Composer

The main theme and BGM are handled by Yasunori Shiono, known for the "Lufia" (Estpolis Denki) series. His melancholic melodies illuminate the nights of Kowloon.

A Solo-Developed Passion Project

A single developer handled the planning, writing, system implementation, and direction, bringing together a cast of 19 voice actors for full voice acting and a legendary composer's original score to create this cinematic drama that pushes the boundaries of the visual novel genre.

About the Donation ver.

This "Donation ver." is designed for players who have enjoyed all episodes of 'Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered' and wish to deepen their interest in the series.

Although the main story is complete in the Free Version (Demo), purchasing this edition grants you the following exclusive benefits:

Unlocks Steam Achievements

This edition supports Steam Achievements, which are unlocked upon achieving various routes and endings. Ideal for completionists who wish to pursue all collecting elements.

Exclusive DLC Access

Artbook/Setting Materials: Includes detailed settings for over 150 characters in the Red Spider series, a map of the setting locations, and a chronology. (Japanese only)

【Important Purchase Notes】

This product does not include additional story content for the main game. All main story routes are included in the Free Version (Demo).

Story

The protagonist, Yvet, is a former assassin who received training at the assassination organization "Spiderweb" in her youth. After leaving the organization for personal reasons, she became the wife of Francis, the leader of the Red Flower Society operating in Kowloon.

One night, Francis is attacked at a nightclub and is diagnosed with no hope of regaining consciousness. Sensing an opportunity for succession, ambitious executives begin to scheme, while the Hong Kong Police plan to intervene in the investigation. As acting chairwoman, Yvet must navigate these power struggles, commanding her bodyguards and trusted detective to identify the mastermind behind her husband's assassination.

Characters

Yvet

The protagonist. After her parents were murdered in her childhood, she was taken in by an assassination organization and trained in various assassination techniques. Following her escape, she was sheltered by Yeung Kwun, the former chairman of the Red Flower Society, and became the wife of his son, Francis. She vows to find and avenge her husband's attacker.

Francis

Yvet's husband. He had pursued a legitimate career as a lawyer, but after his father Yeung Kwun's death, he reluctantly took over as chairman of the Red Flower Society at Yvet's request to quell the succession chaos. He was aware of Yvet's past and made it a condition of his succession that she become his wife. The attack on him reignites the succession struggle.

The Ghost

The Red Flower Society chairman's bodyguard. He has served the family since Yeung Kwun's time. Highly loyal to the organization, he views Yvet with suspicion as she assumes the role of acting chairwoman. To strengthen Yvet's security amidst the succession dispute, he calls in the Luk brothers.

Lai

Yvet's old acquaintance and a detective. He was formerly a police officer. Yvet once saved his life, and out of gratitude, he assists in investigating the attack. He is wary of the Ghost, who seems to be hiding something from Yvet.

Luk
Yvet's security detail, summoned by the Ghost. He possesses a trained physique, calm judgment, and high combat capabilities. However, he is less adept with modern IT technology and relies solely on his younger brother, Shawn, for information gathering. He was once part of the same assassination organization as Yvet.

Shawn
Luk's younger brother. While not highly skilled in combat, he excels at information gathering using the internet. Cracking servers with weak security and developing information-gathering viruses are second nature to him.

Dog Head

A Red Flower Society executive. He was a hot-headed, belligerent fighter who commanded strong trust within the organization. However, he fell under suspicion of plotting Francis's assassination upon the former chairman's death, which subsequently diminished his standing within the Red Flower Society. He has a son named Johnny with his deceased wife.

data.reviews:
“For fans of the Infernal Affairs series or Johnnie To's The Mission, this game hits the absolute bullseye.”
Steam review(Japanese)

“5/5 Stars. I'd gladly pay around 2,000 yen (the price of a movie ticket) for this. (Which is why I bought the soundtrack too.)”
Steam review(Japanese)

“Despite being an indie production, the exceptional dedication to sound, dialogue, and overall direction provides an incredible sense of immersion.”
Steam review(Japanese)
